purpose: Test whether pre-match history maturity/cold-start state adds stable Draw information by allowing the model to distinguish reliable last5 aggregates from short-history versions, in time-ordered competition-season folds.

schema_evidence.observed_summary: home/away last5 match counts are usually 5 but range 0-5; cold_start_flag marks 1526 of 27616 raw rows

folding.train_rule: same-competition rows strictly before the first date of the test season

maturity_features.interpretation: data maturity/reliability state only; no label/result/score information

models.baseline_draw: R39W frozen 9-feature binary Draw logistic, L2=10
models.challenger_draw: baseline 9 features plus the 3 frozen maturity features, binary logistic L2=10
models.conditional_HA: R39W frozen conditional Home-vs-Away logistic on non-draws, L2=10; identical for baseline and challenger
models.solver: deterministic Newton/IRLS with backtracking line search

frozen_gate.coverage: maturity eligible test rows / baseline finite test rows >= 0.995
frozen_gate.fold_draw_log_loss_wins: challenger wins at least 55% of eligible folds
frozen_gate.competition_draw_log_loss_wins: challenger wins at least 60% of competitions with at least two eligible folds
frozen_gate.if_pass: History maturity is a stable incremental Draw control and may proceed to a separately preregistered confirmation; no formal promotion.
frozen_gate.if_fail: Close history-maturity route; the current 41-column source then has no obvious untested football-state/maturity feature family beyond source/stage metadata.
